purpose: Freeze causal data semantics and falsifiable hypotheses for a new crypto spot/perpetual basis+funding challenger before any economics are read.

source_contract.timestamp_policy: UTC only; exchange event timestamps preserved; ingestion timestamp stored separately
source_contract.symbol_mapping_policy: Explicit immutable venue-symbol mapping required before evaluation

feature_definitions.funding_rate: official exchange funding rate applicable at the decision timestamp
feature_definitions.funding_basis_state: ordered pair (instantaneous_basis, funding_rate); no thresholding at prereg stage

causality.decision_inputs: Only observations with exchange event timestamp <= decision timestamp

falsifiable_hypotheses.statement: The signed spot-perpetual basis and currently-known funding state contains forward information about subsequent spot-versus-perpetual relative returns.
The predictive content, if any, remains directionally stable across BTC and ETH and across Binance and OKX under identical feature definitions.
